transport_modes.genuine_acquisition: Explicit supported Linux HTTP acquisition; producer claims remain uploaded-unverified
transport_modes.retained_replay: Verified retained original bytes/receipt; original acquired clock preserved, not fresh source collection
transport_modes.synthetic_fixture: Offline/mocked/safe reduced fixture transport; live importer MUST reject

record_semantics.metadata: Existing normalized v0.2 record; unchanged source-specific field/rights/value meanings
record_semantics.metadata_sha256: SHA256 canonical exact immutable normalized metadata
record_semantics.acquisition_id: References exactly one included source acquisition run with matching source_id and original fetched_at
record_semantics.unchanged_rows: No new local immutable version; durable successful source run/no_change receipt still exported
record_semantics.revisions: Same stable source-qualified upstream ID plus new semantic hash; previous version metadata remains immutable

run_constraints.success_record_witness: HTTP200,positive bounded bytes,complete body,valid64hex raw hash and matching normalized fetched_at
run_constraints.no_rows_on_failure: Failure/no-change/skipped source receipts do not fabricate normalized records
run_constraints.snapshots_and_qualifications: Source edition/model/dimension/method/estimate metadata are bounded witness context; do not become per-cell publication clocks
run_constraints.original_vs_site_clocks: All producer source/acquisition clocks remain separate from Site import/index clocks
run_constraints.normalization_or_cap_failure: Explicit status, gap and last-good preservation; never silently report succeeded0
run_constraints.access_state: 401/402/403 lock exact origin until access review;429 retains actual RetryAfter and cooldown; no auto retry/bypass

live_admission: Separate owner-session manual importer only; new uploaded-unverified records never become reviewed/direct origin. Existing reviewed pins and originalv1/v2 imports remain unchanged. No machine credential or scheduler.
